chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Khalid, from Sa'd ibn Sa'd, from Al-Marzuban who said:

I asked Abu Al-Hasan Al-Reza (peace be upon him) about a man who said to his wife, 'Observe your waiting period, for I have freed your way,' then he bore witness to her reversion (raj'a) after a few days, then remained absent from her before he copulated with her until months passed after the waiting period, or more. So how would you order him? He (peace be upon him) said: 'When he bore witness to his reversion, so she is his wife.'

key_terms.رَجْعَتِهَا: Reversion (return of the wife to the husband's possession in a revocable divorce)
key_terms.يُجَامِعَهَا: He copulates with her / consummates the marriage

ai.seo_question: Does a husband need to physically reunite with his wife to validate the reversion (raj'a) in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: Imam Al-Reza (peace be upon him) clarifies that in a revocable divorce (talaq raj'i), the husband's unilateral declaration of reversion (raj'a) is legally sufficient to restore the marital bond without requiring physical consummation or a new contract. This ruling underscores the Shia jurisprudential view that the husband's word, when witnessed, effectively reinstates the wife during the 'iddah period, even if cohabitation is delayed for months. This highlights the flexibility of the revocable divorce phase, distinguishing it from the irrevocable divorce which requires a new marriage contract.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Khalid, from Sa’ad Bin Sa’ad, from Al Marzuban who said,

‘I asked Abu Al-Hassan Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup> about a man who says to his wife, ‘Begin your waiting period for I have freed your way, and keeps witnesses upon his reversion after a few days, then remains absent from her before he copulates with her until months pass by for that after the waiting period, or more. So how would you<sup>asws</sup> order him?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘When he kept witnesses over his reversion, so she is his wife’.
en.sarwar: 2. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid from Sa‘d ibn Sa‘d from al-Marzuban who has said

the following: “I once asked al-Rida’, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about the case of a man who says to his wife, ‘’1‘tadV (you must commence waiting period); I have opened your way. In few days he arranges witness for his going back to her; then remains absent from her before going to bed with her until months pass from the waiting period or more. What do you command in the case?’ He (the Imam) said, ‘Since he has arranged for witness about his going back to his wife, she is his wife.”’
